shortDescription: CenterPoint Energy NYSE:CNP slips 1.3% in Tuesday's trading as RBC Capital launched coverage with a Sector Perform rating and $40 price target, saying consensus already sits at the high end of the company's 7%-9% earnings per share compound annual growth rate guidance through 2030, and the stock's…

children: slips 1.3% in Tuesday's trading as RBC Capital launched coverage with a Sector Perform rating and $40 price target, saying consensus already sits at the high end of the company's 7%-9% earnings per share compound annual growth rate guidance through 2030, and the stock's ~9% premium to large-cap regulated peers is "difficult to expand despite a derisked Texas regulatory construct."
With ~85% of investments flowing through forward test year rate cases and interim capital trackers through 2030, CenterPoint

has an unusually visible earnings recovery path, RBC analyst Stephen D'Ambrisi said, also viewing the combination of rider-heavy recovery and improving legislative backdrop as "a meaningful derisking of what has historically been a below-average regulatory jurisdiction, but... this is reflected in the stock's valuation."

expects peak load to increase by 50%, or 10 GW, by 2029, driving a best-in-class rate base compound annual growth rate D'Ambrisi estimates at ~11.5% through 2030, compared to management's formal 11% guidance, with $10B-plus of incremental capital providing a credible path to re-acceleration beyond the plan period.
is fairly valued, and he sees better value in names offering comparable growth at more compelling valuations.

title: CenterPoint Energy initiated Sector Perform at RBC as premium-priced vs. peers
